help:
usage: wgsextract microarray [-h] [--download | --no-download] [--formats FORMATS]
                             [--format {tsv,parquet}] [--sample SAMPLE] [-r REGION] [--help-all]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --download, --no-download
                        Allow missing public reference/model downloads; no sample files or genotypes are uploaded. Hosts and request data: docs/privacy.md. Default: config allow_reference_downloads, else off.
  --formats FORMATS     Comma-separated list of formats to generate (default: all).
                        Variants are named by letter (h600.org's Microarray File Formats); similar
                        minor variants are merged into one file, e.g. ancestry_v2ab.
                        Available formats:
                          Combined kits:
                            all, combined_v5 (CombinedKit v5: every chip's markers in one 23andMe-style
                            file, e.g. for GEDmatch; always written, writes no vendor files alone)
                            combined_v3 (CombinedKit v3: classic 14-template subset of CombinedKit v5,
                            written as <sample>_CombinedKit_v3.txt)
                          23andMe:
                            23andme_v2 (also v1: same markers), 23andme_v3, 23andme_v4 (v4a-c),
                            23andme_v5, 23andme_v3+v5, 23andme_api
                          AncestryDNA:
                            ancestry_v1, ancestry_v2ab (v2a and v2b merged; alias: ancestry_v2),
                            ancestry_v2cd (v2c and v2d merged), ancestry_v2e
                          Family Tree DNA:
                            ftdna_v1 (Affymetrix, NCBI36 positions), ftdna_v2 (v2a-d), ftdna_v3, ftdna_v4
                            ftdna_v2y, ftdna_v3y, ftdna_v4y (the separate Y files, GRCh38 positions)
                          Living DNA:
                            ldna_v1, ldna_v2
                          MyHeritage:
                            myheritage_v1, myheritage_v2, myheritage_v3
                          Other vendors:
                            tellmegen, genera, mthfr (MTHFR Genetics), meudna_v1, meudna_v2,
                            selfdecode, nucleus
                          AADR v66.p1 (GRCh37 outputs, PLINK .bed/.bim/.fam AND EIGENSTRAT .geno/.snp/.ind):
                            aadr_1240k, aadr_ho, aadr_1240k+ho (HO is a subset of 1240K in this release)
                            aadr_2m (opt-in; first run 'ref aadr --install'; v66.p1 genetic distances
                              differ from legacy 1240K/HO at 1,200,251 sites; maps are never mixed)
  --format {tsv,parquet}
                        Also save the genotypes as <input>_genotypes.tsv or .parquet (needs pyarrow): rsID, chrom, pos (in the input's build) and genotype
  --sample SAMPLE       Sample to use from a multi-sample VCF (e.g. a joint-called nf-core/sarek VCF); required when the VCF has more than one
  -r, --region REGION   Chromosomal region (e.g. chrM, chrY:10000-20000)
  --help-all            Show this help with the advanced options too, and exit.

global options:
  -i/--input, -o/--outdir, --genome, --ref, -t/--threads, -m/--memory, --json,
  --quiet, --debug, --config and the other global options are accepted before
  or after the command; 'wgsextract --help' lists them all.

15 advanced options not shown; 'wgsextract microarray --help-all' lists them.

examples:
  wgsextract microarray --input sample.cram --formats 23andme_v5
  wgsextract microarray --input sample.cram --formats 23andme_v5,ancestry_v2

outputs (in the output directory unless noted):
  <input stem>_<format>.txt (or the vendor's extension) per format, such as
  sample_23andMe_V5.txt, and <input stem>_CombinedKit.txt; with --format also
  <input stem>_genotypes.tsv or .parquet. Each output gets an
  <output>.inputs.json of the inputs and options that made it; a rerun reuses
  outputs whose inputs are unchanged.

needs:
  bcftools, bgzip, samtools, tabix; depending on options and inputs, also:
  curl; minutes on a 30x genome.

Opt-in sequence-defined I/D probes from a matching GRCh37 Illumina CSV, gzip or ZIP; repeat per selected format
Keep/no-call biallelic A/T or C/G input SNPs; unknown probe alleles are not inferred (default: config or keep)
Resolve packaged dbSNP aliases and no-call retired/ambiguous marker IDs (default: config or false)
corrected: forward-strand calls; vendor: reverse-strand calls where a template's vendor revision reported them so (default: config or corrected)
Minimum sample GQ; missing GQ becomes a no-call (default: config or 20; 0 disables filtering)
Minimum sample DP; missing DP becomes a no-call (default: config or 10; 0 disables filtering)
Assume absent VCF markers are reference on represented contigs (unsafe opt-in; default: config or false; also requires --min-dp 0 --min-gq 0)
No-call VCF records failing FILTER (default: config or true)
Also write CombinedKit_reasons.tsv with explicit reasons (default: config or false)
Non-identifying sample label for AADR .fam/.ind (default: sample)
AADR metadata sex only; does not change genotype calling (default: U)
Call chromosomes in parallel workers (default: on with --threads above 1; calls are identical to one stream)
Master tabulated list of all consumer microarray SNPs (auto-resolved from --ref if possible)
File defining ploidy per chromosome (auto-resolved from --ref if possible)
Sample to use from a multi-sample VCF (e.g. a joint-called nf-core/sarek VCF); required when the VCF has more than one
Chromosomal region (e.g. chrM, chrY:10000-20000)
Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config qc_min_diploid_depth 15, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)
Show this help with the advanced options too, and exit.
